primary_problem: ChatGPT conversations and tool-heavy turns can be interrupted or delayed; project execution state must therefore live outside any single conversation.
user_pain: Additional-verification holds add wall-clock delay and may interrupt an in-progress technical turn
Manual screenshots/copy-paste turn the user into a telemetry bus
Conversation interruption must not force project restart
Legitimate personal software projects should not need to be reduced in ambition merely to survive conversational interruptions
product_requirements: running-job observability independent of a conversation
nonterminal handling of verification holds and 429s
non_goal: Do not bypass or weaken platform safety checks; make interruptions operationally survivable.
